_comment: Worked example of the motion sheet cag reads, traced by MotionArtist. Required: fps, view, playback, frames. Each frame needs i, role and cue; pace, note, pts and features.airborne are optional. Indices run 0..N-1 in order and at least one frame must be key or pilot. cag ignores t, energy, depth and every field of features except airborne.
title: Sample Sway
name: sample

source.title: Easy dance moves for a party, club, wedding 🪩

arc:
Move #3 from the source: a four-second, sixteen-frame loop in a wide, easy stance, facing front. Bar A (frames 0-7) is the wind-up. The arms drop from chest height to the hips on frame 1-2 with a small lean to character-left and the character-right hip lifting, then rise again through frames 3-6 as the weight rocks character-left, character-right, and back to centre. Frame 7 is the hit: both fists at chest height, elbows bent about 90 degrees, knees soft.

Bar B (frames 8-15) holds the fists at the chest and lets the lower body do the work. The hips rock character-left then character-right on alternating frames while the knees pulse; the character-right shoulder stays a touch higher throughout. Frames 11 and 13 are the two side extremes (weight over the character-right foot, then centred with both knees bent). Frame 15 flows straight back into frame 0, which is a fast transition frame rather than a hold, so the loop seam reads as one continuous step.
